question: What was the term of 10th Five Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2002-2007.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first five-year plan in India was launched in 1951 and since then, India has witnessed twelve Five Year Plans. 
 
• 
 The Tenth Five-Year Plan was from 2002 to 2007, under the leadership of Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Manmohan Singh. 
 
 
• 
 Some of the main objectives of the Tenth Five Year Plan were:__

 __
 
• 
 ​This plan aimed to double the Per Capita Income of India in the next 10 years.
 
 
• 
 It also aimed to reduce the poverty ratio to 15% by 2012.
 
 
• 
 Its growth target was 8.0% but it achieved only 7.6%.
 
 
• 
 One of the unique objectives was to reduce gender-based discrimination.
 
 
• 
 
It gave importance to providing training and employment opportunities to women.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Five-Year Plans were laid to rest by the Narendra Modi-led NDA government in 2015.
 
• Hence, the 12th five-year plan is considered the last five-year plan of India.
 
• The decades-old Five-Year Plans was replaced by a three-year action plan, which will be part of a seven-year strategy paper and a 15-year vision document. 
 
•
